description: Creates an empty watchlist (a named set of creators) and returns its watchlistId. Fill it with add_watchlist_profiles, then pass the id to search_outliers as watchlistId to scope any search to exactly those accounts. Watchlists created here appear in the owner's web app too. Free to call. Watchlists count against a workspace allowance that comes from a subscription or is earned from API spend (every API key holder starts with 1); an over-limit call explains what unlocks more. Cost: free.
name: create_watchlist
title: Create a Watchlist
